newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends 2.6 higher at 1,055.90.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends 2.6 higher at 1,055.90.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 16 Reuter - Colombia's peso ended 2.6 pesos higher against the dollar at 1,055.90 on active selling of U.S. currency by the corporate sector and banks, dealers in the interbank market said.
They said a rise in foreign capital inflows, especially dollars, was the leading reason that the peso closed higher for the second consecutive day.
Wednesday's session was shortened by one hour due to a power failure at interbank trading headquarters.
Dealers reported 246 trades for a total of 98.7 million pesos. The currency closed just off its high for the day of 1,055.80.
